holdf5.config.title: HoldF5 Config
holdf5.config.subtitle: Rules-safe temporary perspective with configurable presentation.
holdf5.config.perspective.label: Perspective
holdf5.config.transition_speed.label: Transition Speed
holdf5.config.motion_blur.label: Motion Blur
holdf5.config.motion_blur_mode.label: Blur Mode
holdf5.config.motion_blur_strength.label: Blur Strength
holdf5.config.perspective.desc: Choose which fixed third-person view is used while the key is held.
holdf5.config.transition_speed.desc: Controls how quickly the camera moves into the held perspective.
holdf5.config.separate_transition_speeds: Enable a different speed for returning to first person after release.
holdf5.config.release_transition_speed.d: Controls how quickly the camera returns after the key is released.
holdf5.config.motion_blur.desc: Adds a lightweight blur effect without changing camera behavior.
holdf5.config.motion_blur_mode.desc: Apply blur only during camera movement or for the full hold duration.
holdf5.config.motion_blur_strength.desc: Higher values produce a stronger blend between recent frames.
holdf5.config.gui_scale_warning: GUI scale Auto or 4 may cause this menu to display poorly.
holdf5.config.motion_blur.fallback: Motion blur was disabled because the shader could not be initialized.
holdf5.firstuse.title: HoldF5
holdf5.firstuse.body: Hold the configured key to switch perspective. You can customize transition speed, motion blur and more in the settings.
